fact: At the October 2024 mission the government-wide cloud strategy indicator stood at No (target Yes by end-2026), and a World Bank-funded technical assistance on public data hosting, with Roland Berger, was to hold its first mission the week of 18 November 2024 to recommend modernisation of data hosting infrastructure.
title: Mission d'appui à la mise en œuvre et de revue à mi-parcours, Projet de gouvernance numérique du secteur public (PGNSP), Aide-mémoire
